structure: Single high school course 'Filipino History Culture'. Page 1-2: table of Inquiry Standards SS.9-12.1.1-5.4 under Anchor Standards 1-5. Pages 3-9: six themes (Theme N title, Sample Compelling Questions row, then a 4-column table Anchor Standard / Topic / Content Standard / Sample Content/Concepts). Each theme lists two or so content standards borrowed from other courses' codes (e.g. SS.3.2.7.3); the 4th column holds sample content bullets.
